name: ie-corporation-tax
description: Irish corporation tax for tax year 2026 (accounting periods ending in 2026) for an Irish-resident company. Covers the 12.5% trading rate (section 21 TCA 1997), the 25% rate on passive income and excepted trades (section 21A), company gains grossed up at the 31% CGT rate for disposals from 7 October 2026 (33% before that date and on development land), the Pillar Two 15% minimum tax (Part 4A, scope only), close-company surcharges, preliminary tax, losses and group relief, start-up relief, the R&D credit (30%, or 35% for periods ending 31 December 2026 or later), the Knowledge Development Box (10% effective rate), interest limitation, and CT1 filing on ROS. Trigger on: Ireland corporation tax, CT1, 12.5% rate, preliminary CT, R&D credit Ireland, KDB, close company surcharge, Pillar Two Ireland.
